note: F1/F2/F6/F7/F9/F13/F17 are dynamically reproduced against the shipped code; the rest are source-demonstrated because no DSH runtime is required to read them. The mandatory REAL Parent-IPC preservation gate is established in C2 (test/trajectory_p2d0_ipc_preservation.test.ts).

F1.finding: the Parent-observed A/B/C conflict disappears before durability
F1.method: drive the shipped port logic (tracker.observe -> tracker.observation -> sink) and read the durable store
F1.observed: the tracker rebuilds ONE observation whose dshSessionId is always the first; the durable candidate set is {worker-A} and B/C are absent
F1.expectedInvariant: every distinct valid IPC Session identity report must reach durable ingestion as an immutable candidate

F2.finding: one qualified + one incomplete Invocation reports SELECTED_UNIQUE
F2.method: real product install + real attributed preview + controlled association
F2.observed: selection.state = SELECTED_UNIQUE with detail claiming no unresolved alternative, while a second invocation is OBSERVATION_INCOMPLETE
F2.expectedInvariant: an automatic unique selection may occur only when the whole relevant Invocation set justifies it

F3.method: source inspection of the adapter between the page read and the invariant check
F3.observed: the adapter reads the page and builds the binding with no second store-head comparison
F3.expectedInvariant: a conflict committed during Event Read must not be admitted as current verified attribution

F4.finding: aggregate qualification captures ONE basis for the whole pass
F4.observed: qualifyAttempt captures storeHeadAtStart once and every invocation rechecks only against it
F4.expectedInvariant: the multi-invocation result must be bound to one confirmed basis, or each result to its own

F5.finding: the delegation finalizes with the single closeReason INVOCATION_RETURNED
F5.method: source inspection of contract.ts and continuation.ts
F5.observed: the port resolves from the timeout/abort handler before any close is observed; the delegation records CLOSED with INVOCATION_RETURNED for both
F5.expectedInvariant: a timeout/abort request is not proof of child closure

F6.finding: one Job terminal closes every Invocation of the Attempt
F6.method: drive finalizeAttempt with two recorded invocations
F6.observed: finalizeAttempt returns two outcomes and both windows are recorded CLOSED
F6.expectedInvariant: a terminal event for Job J must only finalize its own Invocation

F7.finding: two Attempts both qualify the same source-scoped Session identity
F7.method: record the same SessionId for two attempts and qualify both
F7.observed: both qualifications are ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED with no cross-attempt creator conflict
F7.expectedInvariant: two incompatible fresh-creation claims for the same source-scoped SessionId must not both qualify silently

F8.observed: events are refused but sessionLifecycle, eventPageCoverage and completeness are not gated on the invariant verdict
F8.expectedInvariant: a refused page must not claim SESSION_READ + FULL + COMPLETE

F9.observed: verification VERIFIED with a durableBindingRef from an in-memory store
F9.expectedInvariant: an in-memory-only association must not claim cold-recoverable durability

F10.finding: reader async disposal is not awaited
F10.method: source inspection of lifecycle.ts and the cluster
F10.observed: OwnedResource.close is synchronous and the reader async close is voided
F10.expectedInvariant: await installed.dispose() must wait for the mounted Reader close

F11.observed: an expert port replaces the derived one while the basis and FIRST_PARTY_DSH_HOST kind still come from workWorkerBin
F11.expectedInvariant: a stub must not become first-party-qualified by borrowing the DSH Bin path

F12.observed: the reader is composed only when DSH_HOME is explicitly set
F12.expectedInvariant: the supported default-home behavior must be source-grounded

F13.method: real product install + attributed preview with a real canonical attempt
F13.observed: resultRefs [], verificationState NOT_OBSERVED_BY_P2C, reworkState NONE, null basis, empty project evolution
F13.expectedInvariant: the attributed preview must not silently lose facts the V0 composition can establish

F14.finding: Caller Claim disagreement is not explicitly reported
F14.observed: the claim is recorded but a disagreement with the verified SessionId is not reported as a discrepancy
F14.expectedInvariant: the discrepancy must be explicitly reported

F15.observed: previewAttempt admits any canonical Attempt of the project with no consumer-Attempt binding
F15.expectedInvariant: the consumer-side authority must be the Work/Rework lineage or Context allowlist

F16.method: source inspection of prior_result.ts, manifest.ts, service.ts, work_worker.ts
F16.observed: PriorResultContext compiled into the per-Attempt ContextManifest, delivered through the attempt-bound pull allowlist
F16.expectedInvariant: the narrowest correct Capsule delivery reuses this mechanism; no unrestricted session-read tool

F17.method: source inspection of the cluster and install.ts
F17.observed: the cluster accepts epochs but the install options do not expose them and install.ts never passes them
F17.expectedInvariant: a normal deployment must be able to supply trusted historical epochs after an upgrade

F18.method: source inspection of launch.ts and install.ts
F18.observed: Deployment.installed is typed InstalledPalimpsest while the runtime carries trajectory
F18.expectedInvariant: the extended installed capability must be statically reachable through the supported deployment surface
